query: WITH notification_policies AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', policyname, 'command', cmd, 'using', qual) ORDER BY policyname) AS items FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'edutech_notifications'), duplicate_reads AS (SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT notification_id, user_id FROM public.edutech_notification_reads GROUP BY notification_id, user_id HAVING count(*) > 1) AS duplicates), invalid_targets AS (SELECT count(*) AS value FROM public.edutech_notifications WHERE (target_type = 'all' AND (target_user_id IS NOT NULL OR target_level IS NOT NULL OR target_series IS NOT NULL)) OR (target_type = 'level' AND (target_user_id IS NOT NULL OR target_level IS NULL OR target_series IS NOT NULL)) OR (target_type = 'level_series' AND (target_user_id IS NOT NULL OR target_level IS NULL OR target_series IS NULL)) OR (target_type = 'user' AND (target_user_id IS NULL OR target_level IS NOT NULL OR target_series IS NOT NULL))), admin_tables AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', tablename, 'rls', rowsecurity) ORDER BY tablename) AS items FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename IN ('edutech_notifications','edutech_notification_reads','edutech_term_evaluation_sessions','edutech_archived_annual_reports')) SELECT jsonb_build_object('notification_policies', notification_policies.items, 'duplicate_reads', duplicate_reads.value, 'invalid_targets', invalid_targets.value, 'admin_tables', admin_tables.items) AS audit FROM notification_policies CROSS JOIN duplicate_reads CROSS JOIN invalid_targets CROSS JOIN admin_tables LIMIT 1;
